title: Secondary School
subtitle: 本課限定語境：secondary school = a school providing education after primary/elementary education
description: 本課限定語境：secondary school = a school providing education after primary/elementary education and before higher education, usually for adolescents · 「中學；提供小學後、中等程度教育的學校」

words.meaning: 高中；中學（視教育制度而定）
words.note: 在美式英語中，通常指學生在大學前就讀的較高階段學校。
words.example: She teaches mathematics at a public high school.
words.exampleZh: 她在一所公立高中教授數學。

exercises.original: In the United States, she teaches at a secondary school for students in grades 9 to 12.
exercises.zh: 在美國，她在一所教授九至十二年級學生的中學任教。
exercises.upgrade: In the United States, she teaches at a high school for students in grades 9 to 12.

options.explanation: 在美國，middle school 通常是較低年級，常見為 grades 6–8 左右，和 9–12 不符。
United States + grades 9 to 12 是 high school 的典型制度範圍。
在美國通常是高等教育，不是 grades 9–12。
是英國等制度的較高年級階段，不是美國中學的一般名稱。

exercises.original: He graduated from secondary school in the United States before starting university.
exercises.zh: 他在美國完成高中後才升讀大學。
exercises.upgrade: He graduated from high school in the United States before starting university.

options.explanation: 美國學生在 university/college 前完成的最後一般中學階段就是 high school。
完成 middle school 後通常還會升 high school，不會直接開始 university。
屬大學之後的研究生教育。

exercises.original: The exchange programme places teenagers in American secondary schools.
exercises.zh: 這項交流計劃安排青少年到美國高中就讀。
exercises.upgrade: The exchange programme places teenagers in American high schools.

options.explanation: American + teenagers 是典型 high-school exchange programme 語境。
teenagers 可能有例外，但一般 exchange programme for secondary pupils 不是 university。
這是英國制度詞，而且 only 過度限制。

words.note: 表示 primary education 之後的學校。
words.example: Students usually move to a post-primary school after completing primary education.
words.exampleZh: 學生完成小學教育後通常升讀中學。

exercises.original: In Ireland, students normally enter secondary school after primary education.
exercises.zh: 在愛爾蘭，學生通常完成小學後升讀中學。
exercises.upgrade: In Ireland, students normally enter post-primary school after primary education.

options.explanation: In Ireland + after primary education 是非常清楚的制度線索；post-primary 是當地自然教育術語。
高等教育通常在 secondary/post-primary education 之後。
原句正說完成 primary education 後再升學。
不是愛爾蘭一般 post-primary 教育的完整名稱，而且 only 過窄。

exercises.original: The policy applies to all secondary schools in the Irish education system.
exercises.zh: 這項政策適用於愛爾蘭教育制度中的所有中學。
exercises.upgrade: The policy applies to all post-primary schools in the Irish education system.

options.explanation: 在愛爾蘭官方及教育語境中，post-primary 是常見的中等教育層級名稱。
是美式小學詞，而且制度層級不同。
college 的意思不穩定，也不能涵蓋所有 post-primary schools。

exercises.original: Teachers working in secondary schools attended the post-primary education conference.
exercises.zh: 在中學任教的教師參加了中等教育會議。
exercises.upgrade: Teachers working in post-primary schools attended the post-primary education conference.

options.explanation: 句中已出現 post-primary education conference，因此相同制度術語最自然。
與 conference 的教育層級不同。
不是完整對應，而且 only 不合理。

words.meaning: 中等教育學校；中學階段學校
words.note: 較正式、描述性地表示提供 secondary-level education 的學校。
words.example: The programme supports teachers working in secondary-level schools.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃支援在中學階段學校工作的教師。

exercises.original: The survey compared teachers from primary and secondary schools in five countries.
exercises.zh: 調查比較五個國家的小學和中學教師。
exercises.upgrade: The survey compared teachers from primary and secondary-level schools in five countries.

options.explanation: five countries 表示跨制度比較，使用 descriptive secondary-level 可避免假設每國都用同一校名。
會重複前一組而失去比較。
secondary education 不只職業教育，而且 only 太窄。

exercises.original: The programme provides training for teachers in secondary schools across different education systems.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃為不同教育制度中的中學教師提供培訓。
exercises.upgrade: The programme provides training for teachers in secondary-level schools across different education systems.

options.explanation: across different education systems 是最重要線索。secondary-level 是制度中立、適合國際比較的描述。
high school 的年級範圍受地區影響，不能代表所有國家的整個 secondary level。
只涵蓋某些制度中的最後階段。

exercises.original: Researchers examined student wellbeing in secondary schools rather than universities.
exercises.zh: 研究人員研究中學而非大學學生的福祉。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers examined student wellbeing in secondary-level schools rather than universities.

options.explanation: 和 universities 作教育階段對比時，secondary-level schools 是正式而清楚的分類詞。
和 universities 同屬高等教育，並非對比的一方。
college 定義受地區影響且過窄。

words.note: 最直接的解釋性 paraphrase，清楚說明學校的教育層級。
words.example: The town has one school for secondary education and three primary schools.
words.exampleZh: 該鎮有一所提供中等教育的學校和三所小學。

exercises.original: The village has one secondary school and three primary schools.
exercises.zh: 這條村有一所中學和三所小學。
exercises.upgrade: The village has one school for secondary education and three primary schools.

options.explanation: 這是最透明的解釋性改寫，直接說明學校提供的是 secondary education。
會令句子變成四所小學，失去原有教育層級區別。

exercises.original: After finishing primary school, she enrolled in a secondary school nearby.
exercises.zh: 完成小學後，她入讀附近一所提供中等教育的學校。
exercises.upgrade: After finishing primary school, she enrolled in a school for secondary education nearby.

options.explanation: after finishing primary school 明確指出下一階段是 secondary education。

exercises.original: The new secondary school will serve students from several surrounding towns.
exercises.zh: 新中學將服務附近多個城鎮的學生。
exercises.upgrade: The new school for secondary education will serve students from several surrounding towns.

options.explanation: 作 definition-style paraphrase 時，這個長形式能完整保留教育層級。
是大學院系，不是一所中學。
職業訓練中心不一定屬 secondary education，only 也過度限制。

words.meaning: 高年級學校；較高階段學校
words.note: 在某些教育制度或學校組織中，表示較高年級學生就讀的學校／校部。
words.example: Students move into the senior school at the next stage of their education.
words.exampleZh: 學生在下一教育階段升入高年級學校。

exercises.original: In this school system, older secondary pupils study in the senior school.
exercises.zh: 在這個學校體系中，年紀較大的中學生在高年級校部就讀。
exercises.upgrade: In this school system, older secondary pupils study in the senior school.

options.explanation: older secondary pupils + this school system 表明這是某校制中的高年級 division，senior school 合適。
通常是較低年級，和 older pupils 相反。
通常是較低 secondary years，而不是 senior division。

exercises.original: Students move from the junior section into the secondary school's senior section at age fourteen.
exercises.zh: 學生十四歲時由初級校部升入高年級校部。
exercises.upgrade: Students move from the junior section into the senior school at age fourteen.

options.explanation: junior section 的直接制度對應是 senior school / senior section；這是校內階段劃分。
sixth form 通常約 16–18 歲，且只是最後階段；十四歲通常過早。
地域含義不穩定，不能根據這句確定。

exercises.original: The independent school has separate junior and secondary divisions, with older pupils based in the senior school.
exercises.zh: 這所獨立學校設有不同年級校部，較年長學生在高年級校部就讀。
exercises.upgrade: The independent school has separate junior and secondary divisions, with older pupils based in the senior school.

options.explanation: independent school + junior + older pupils 是 senior school 這個制度詞較自然的語境。
middle school 是特定制度名稱，不應由 older pupils 自動推斷；necessarily 亦不自然。
graduate 通常指大學後階段。

falseSynonyms.zh: 初中階段 ≠ 完整 secondary school 在美國等制度中，middle school 通常只涵蓋較低的 secondary years。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Middle school is one stage of secondary education in some systems. High school is a later stage.

falseSynonyms.zh: 小學 ≠ 中學 primary school 位於 secondary school 之前。
小學（AmE） ≠ 中學 elementary school 是美式英語中的小學階段。
學院／大專／某些地區的中學名稱 ≠ 通用同義詞 college 的意思高度地域化。 在美國通常指高等教育；在英國、愛爾蘭等地也可能有其他制度含義。
大學 ≠ 中學 university 屬高等教育，通常在 secondary education 之後。
中學最後階段 ≠ 整所中學 在英格蘭、威爾斯等制度中，sixth form 通常只指 16–18 歲左右的最後兩年。
形容詞 vs 名詞短語 - secondary = 中等的；次要的（形容詞） - secondary school = 中學（名詞短語）
機構 vs 教育過程 - school = 學校 - schooling = 學校教育／受教育過程 不能把 secondary schooling 當成一所 secondary school。
